summary: Iteration 7 — full backend + frontend validation of new bulk-delete feature (Clear all / Clear filtered), Export CSV first backup, demo re-seed suppression via settings.demo_dismissed, and Reload demo button. Backend: added tests/test_bulk_delete.py (9 tests) covering DELETE /api/records with analyte filter (4 deleted, remaining 36), with instrument+analyte filter (4 deleted, remaining 32), full delete (remaining 0), backend restart after full-delete does NOT re-seed (GET /api/records returns []), POST /api/seed clears the flag and repopulates to 40, POST /api/seed is idempotent (still 40, no duplicates), single DELETE /api/records/{id} regression, and final baseline restoration to 40 records. Full pytest suite: 34 passed (25 pre-existing + 9 new) in 11.5s, JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter7.xml. Frontend Playwright walkthrough on Lab Records tab: (1) button label 'Clear all' with no filter, count=40, description says 'all instruments and analytes'; (2) Export CSV first triggers download 'sigmalab-records-backup-2026-09-10.csv' with 41 lines (1 header + 40 data rows) matching records-clear-count=40; (3) Cancel closes dialog without deleting; (4) setting analyte filter to Sodium switches label to 'Clear filtered', count=4, description mentions 'Sodium'; (5) confirming shows toast 'Deleted 4 records', sigma-alerts-count drops 4→3; (6) Clear all → confirm shows empty-state row 'No records. Add one from the Calculator tab.', records-reload-demo-button appears, records-clear-button becomes disabled; (7) full page reload keeps 0 records + reload-demo button (no auto reseed by backend startup); (8) records-reload-demo-button click yields toast 'Demo data loaded — 40 records', table repopulates, reload-demo button disappears; (9) Reports tab export-csv-button downloads 'sigmalab-qc-report-2026-09-10.csv' with 13 columns [Analyte, Category, Matrix, Instrument, Lot, Date, TEa%, CV%, Bias%, Sigma, QGI, Westgard Rules, Performance]. No console errors during the flow. DB left with 40 demo records as required.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py delete_records marks demo_dismissed even for filtered deletes that leave records behind. This is intentional per the spec ('after ANY bulk delete') but worth noting: if a user later deletes the remaining records individually via the row trash icon, no auto-reseed occurs on restart — which is correct behaviour for this UX but relies on the earlier bulk-delete flag. Consider also setting the flag when the collection reaches zero via any path (e.g. delete_record) for symmetry.

seed_endpoint always deletes demo_dismissed then reseeds only when empty — if the user calls POST /api/seed while records exist, the flag is cleared but no records are added. That means the next backend restart with an empty DB would then reseed. Minor edge case; current UX only exposes seed via the Load-demo button which is hidden when records exist.
seed_data_creation: Tests cycle through delete → restart → seed. Final DB state: 40 demo records restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk-delete tests must run serialized (they restart backend). test_bulk_delete.py uses -n 0 wouldn't work because pytest.ini forces -n 2; loadscope pins the module to a single worker, so it's safe as-is. If you add more tests that share state with lab_records, keep them in the same module or clear+seed in fixtures. Baseline: 40 records, 378 analytes.
